text:
Lina M.: Rolling an IAM change to limit keystore decrypt across accounts. Posting details before I apply.
Carlos V.: paste policy? want to make sure we don't break cross-region unwraps for proxies.
Lina M.: binding: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter -> serviceAccount:keystore@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com with condition resource.name.startsWith('projects/redwood/locations/*/keyRings/keystore').
Eve R.: caution: some regions emit protoPayload.resourceName in logs as short form `projects/redwood/locations/<region>/cryptoKeyVersions/<id>` (no keyRing/cryptoKey). startsWith may miss those.
ops-bot: ALERT: 3188890050 - KMS.DecryptAccessDenied spike detected in ap-northeast-2 (10 fails / 2m).
Carlos V.: seeing TLS handshakes fail on ap-northeast edge: "failed to get key material: KMS.DecryptAccessDenied". This aligns with rollout time.
Lina M.: rolling a temporary time-limited allow and will update the condition to match both full and versioned paths. Revert ETA 8m.
Eve R.: also reduce keystore unwrap retry rate on canary proxies to avoid a retry storm. throttle to exponential backoff.
Lina M.: applied temporary grant at 15:42 UTC. monitoring.
ops-bot: UPDATE: 3188890600 - KMS.DecryptAccessDenied back to 0 after temporary grant.
Carlos V.: handshakes recovered, no further client errors.
Lina M.: follow-ups: 1) update IAM template to use regex that covers `/keyRings/.*/cryptoKeys/.*/cryptoKeyVersions/` and the short `cryptoKeyVersions` path, 2) add unit test asserting condition matches audit protoPayload examples, 3) add runbook step: run KMS deny audit query before any scheduled cert rotation in a region, 4) note to throttle unwrap retries during rollout windows.
Eve R.: will draft patch for the IAM template and tests. schedule a quick sync tomorrow to approve.
Lina M.: filing incident ticket and linking this thread. thanks. :white_check_mark:
